This was missed by prior daily reviews; discovered today while investigating MOD's continued price decline, which turns out to be substantially explained by the spin-off's value transfer (MOD dropped ~10% intraday on the 9/28 ex-date) rather than generic 'AI-data-center-adjacent/industrials weakness' as previously assumed. AST SpaceMobile sourced from the 9/8 weekly theme screen (direct-to-cell satellite connectivity).
